evidence.description: The notification service is obtained directly from NotificationCenter.default rather than supplied as a dependency.
The manager uses the hard-coded notification service to broadcast authentication state changes.
dispatchAuthState directly accesses the shared window registry to obtain registered windows.

candidates.explanation: The manager directly obtains operational dependencies through NotificationCenter.default and EcosiaAuthWindowRegistry.shared. These services provide notification delivery and window registration lookup, but neither is supplied through an explicit replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access
